name: Instrument: Build the brief's team slot list and its record mark (gated on `86ajgn2z5`)
text_content:
I1, extending Session 4's brief spine (86akh6779, 86akh5uk4) and Session 8's designation block and room designation's card (86akhcz4d, 86akhcz4g). The four items in priority with one sentence each on what the item is and who speaks it; the refused list; the ceiling as a reset parameter and the compressed-window rule; the record mark (which item ran, or dropped). Sits after the readiness block, ends at the scene trigger, survives a thirty-second brief by dropping whole, is the same list on the room designation's card, is spoken in the team's languages, and feeds row 119 and the slot count. Refuses an item about a person beyond a page fact, a script, a survey, an opener, a personal share, a lagging figure, an announced change, a build item, and a fifth item. Lives on the brief's block on the OS surface and the room designation's card, a build; owned by the owner of the room, every brief, with the reviewing lead choosing the capture. High. Gated on 86ajgn2z5, 86akh3tg0 for the principle item, and the chef ruling for the pass owner's line.

Filed by Session 10 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmj2u. Reasoning lives on the S10 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
